fitGroups.description: Red Energy FIT - GST included if any

incentives.description: Receive 3 hours of primary load free electricity usage daily (up to 24kWh) from 11am-2pm in NSW. Controlled load charges still apply during the free usage period.  This plan is ideal for customers able to shift their energy consumption to these specific windows; failure to do so may result in higher overall costs. Please note that usage exceeding the 24kWh reasonable use cap during the free period may incur standard charges.

plans.terms: This offer is available to residential customers currently within the Endeavour distribution zone with applicable network tariff. Please visit www.redenergy.com.au/terms for full T&Cs applicable to this offer. Solar Feed-In T&Cs can be found at www.redenergy.com.au/solar-feed-in-tariffs. All times are AEST, unless you have an interval meter, in which case daylight savings time will apply.
